articles.title: Trump and Xi Toast Friendship at White House State Dinner, But No Deals Yet
articles.summary: President Trump hosted China's President Xi for a lavish state dinner, giving him a bald eagle sculpture. Both leaders promised cooperation, but experts say the visit has produced no concrete progress on major disputes.

articles.title: Trump and Xi Meet at White House: AI, Trade, Taiwan, and Iran on the Table
articles.summary: Chinese leader Xi Jinping visited the White House for the first time in over a decade. He and President Trump discussed trade, AI, Taiwan, and Iran — and agreed to extend a trade truce. A second U.S. arms package to Taiwan is on hold.

articles.title: Red Carpet for Xi, But Trade Truce Only Lasts a Few Months
articles.summary: President Trump welcomed China's Xi Jinping to the White House with a red carpet — but Xi didn't get the year-long trade truce he wanted. The pause lasts only from November to January, leaving tariffs and Taiwan unresolved.
